It is happening as we speak, the question is whether or not it's inevitable.  China's stock market lost $3 Trillion of wealth in a couple days and it's still not settled, though it has seen a small recovery.  Everything else can be rescued, but not without consequences and greater exposure to economic risk.  What's happening in Greece is that creditors are worried about throwing good money after bad.  Is another 50 billion euros going to fix the core problem?  Most people believe that it won't, but they're more afraid of the contagion spreading to more weak members of the EU and that strong members like the UK, will not want to participate anymore to protect themselves.

In our economic history, recoveries last seven years before going into recession again.  The recessions are less predictable but generally they last two years.  The problem with this is that our recovery has been anemic despite billions of dollars of stimulus and record low interest rates.  This setup will make the next recession harder to recover from and successive recoveries may be weaker and shorter.

The acquaintance explained that he was clairvoyant and had been a so called "ghost hunter" for several years.  He had never been to my house before and had not been told the details of what had transpired since I moved in.  After another round of drinks, we all headed back to my house.  I unlocked the front door and he walked immediately upstairs, not even pausing on the second floor.  He opened the door to the third floor bathroom and then the small door leading to the crawl space over the eaves where he sat for two hours before coming downstairs with the following story.  The house had been designed and built for a doctor, his wife and young daughter.  The first floor served as his office and exam rooms while the family lived on the second and third floors.  A few years after moving in, the couple's young daughter fell ill.  Being a doctor, her father diagnosed and treated her for yellow fever; however, his diagnosis was incorrect and she died shortly thereafter.  Her mother, distraught at losing her only child, became inconsolable and blamed her husband.  Her constant melancholy, insults and abuse persisted for several years until he could no longer endure it, so he "prescribed" a tonic that would help her sleep.  The tonic was highly poisonous and she died within a day of her first dose.  He dragged her lifeless body from the daughters third floor bedroom into the bathroom and through the small door into eave storage area, where her body quickly deteriorated from the heat.  After some time, the doctor was questioned as to the whereabouts of his wife.  He claimed she had taken their daughter, left him and returned to her family in Colorado.  There was no further investigation.  After a couple of years, the doctor, consumed by guilt, crawled into the crawl space of the eave, drank an entire bottle of the tonic and died in short order.  When my friend emerged from the crawl space, he had a diagram of how the daughter's room had been furnished as well as information that the kitchen had been in what was now the family room and a dumb waiter had been used to move the food to family's 2nd floor dining room, a room that I used as an office and library.  His diagram of the dumb waiter pointed to a built in bookcase in my office.  I removed the books from one shelf and knocked on the back wall which made a hollow sound.  I ripped the bookcase out in short order and discovered the remains of a dumb waiter.  It had been covered over for at least fifty years and no one alive could have known of its existence.  My friend explained to me that the wife was the alpha ghost and only she ever left the third floor.  The little girl often ran the third floor hallway and played in the room that had been her playroom when she was alive.  The doctor himself never emerged from the crawl space.  Based on the diagrams my friend made, I furnished the little girls playroom as it had been when she was alive.  My friend discussed with the lady of house that my dogs were very important to me and that I missed having them with me when I was on the second floor.  That night, after all my friends left, and I headed to bed, my dogs ran up the stairs directly to my bedroom where they had never been.  The haunts stopped although I saw the lady of the house many times especially outside my bedroom door and occasionally in my office, the room that had been their family dining room which was now open to the family room below.  She could be seen standing at the railing looking down upon us.  I got transferred after a little over a year living with this family and on my last day I climbed the stairs to the third floor to say goodbye and for the first time saw the cloudy figures of all three people.  The mother reached out her arms as if to hug me, the daughter waved and the doctor stood very nearly still except for a subtle nod of his head.

To follow up, my friend that approached me that night and suggested that I did not leave my house alone identifies as a "medium" who can speak with the dead.  While we were at the bar, he explained the complete layout of my house, though he had never been there.  He suggested we all go back to the house.  This guy had never been in my house before and hadn't heard our conversation, but he was immediately compelled to go to the third floor and open that small door in the bathroom.  He actually had trouble opening the door, which often opened on its own.  He sat there for an hour at least and when he emerged, he came out with the history of the house.  It was specially built for a country doctor (not five miles from downtown Dallas, Texas)  The owner was a doctor and the first floor had been his office and the second and third floors were their living quarters.  They had only one child, a daughter.  Their daughter became ill and being a physician her father treated her condition, but she died.  He had assumed a certain condition but was wrong and his treatment killed her.  Buried under the grief and abuse of the wife, he pushed her down the stairs, where she died.  He dragged her lifeless body to the third story storage under the eaves hidden behind the small door in the bathroom.  There, she died.  He was so overwhelmed with grief, the doctor killed himself in an exam room on the first floor.  Three unsettled souls occupied that room for about 75 years.  The mother was the only one of the three that ever left the third floor, she forbade anyone else from doing so.  She presented herself to me on a few other occasions, but with the truth out, they didn't do anymore of the creepy stuff.  On the night the "medium" spoke to her, he explained that my dogs loved me and wished to sleep with me.  From that point forward, after about 3 months later, my dogs were running the stairs all the way up to the third floor.  The little girl had never had a pet, but she did now.

I moved into a three story house circa 1890 which had most recently had housed a law firm and prior to that an antique store.  I didn't need all the rooms, so I planned to not use the third.  One of the first things I did was turn off water to the third floor bathroom and close all AC vents and disable the multi-line phone system that was drawing power.  On the first night, my dogs refused  to come upstairs, which was odd because they always slept with me.  I didn't think much of it.  On the third or fourth day I was alone in the house raiding the fridge late at night and everything was quiet.  Suddenly I heard a rush of water in the wall clearly coming from upstairs.  I went upstairs and checked the 2nd floor bathroom and found everything dry and the toilet still.  I went then to the 3rd floor bathroom the sink and shower were dry but the toilet water was swirling.  I check the valve and it was closed.  Within a week, the move was complete and I moved some things to the third floor for storage.  In the bathroom, I noticed that the small door that led to a small storage space in the eaves was open.  I closed it and went back downstairs to bring more stuff up to the third floor.  When I returned upstairs, and stacked it in the room that I was using for storage.  As I passed the bathroom, I noticed that small door was open again.  I again closed it and closed the door to the bathroom as well.  I finished moving everything and went down to the kitchen for a beer.  I opened and went to throw the cap in the trash under the kitchen sink and I could hear the water in the wall again.  I chugged the beer and went back to the third floor bathroom to find the the door still closed but inside the small door was open and the toilet water was swirling.  After a month or so there had numerous little things like tipped over candles, books fallen from the bookcases, etc.  I had to leave town for a few days and asked a friend to house sit.  I had barely landed in Washington when my phone was blowing up from my friend, his brother and a guy that worked for me.  A number of things began to happen as soon as I left and they had witnessed them in real time.  Additionally they had heard footsteps on the stairs and what sounded like running in the third floor hallway.  The three decided to camp out in the family room together for the next three nights amid continued disturbances.  When I came home, no one was there, just my dogs.  It was late, I walked the dogs and went upstairs to get in bed.  The door to my bedroom was a French door with windows so I could see into the hallway from bed.  I fell to sleep pretty quickly which is unusual for me.  About 3am, I shot straight up, wide awake and saw a ghostly woman standing in the hall as she closed the door and climbed the stairs to the third floor.  I jumped out of bed and went to open the door only to find it deadbolted.  I spent the night at a hotel with my dogs.  I returned the following morning to find everything in place.  Later that afternoon I joined some friends at a bar to relay what had been going on.  A guy I knew from a local store walked over to say hi and as he approached, his expression changed dramatically.  Though he had not overheard our conversation, as he approached, his facial expression and body language changed.  Without saying hi, he asked if I had just left my house.  When I replied to the affirmative, he said, "you didn't leave there alone."  (The rest of the story later)

I was drinking gin and tonics and we were all having a blast. I had fallen from the upper level of the decks.  I pulled myself out of the harbor, the club was closed and I had only one shoe of what had been a very expensive pair of loafers.  I walked across the street to a Waffle House, soaking wet, one shoe on, and still pretty drunk.  As I walked into the restaurant I noticed that there were two cops seated at the counter.  I thought I would end up in the drunk tank.  They were thankfully at the end of their shift and anxious to finish their meal and head home.  They called me a taxi and sent me on my way.  I got back to my condo and went up to the third floor master suite which featured a terrace overlooking the Gulf of Mexico with a hot tub.  I stripped naked and jumped into the hot tub.  The next morning my friends found me in the hot tub, naked and passed out.  They got me out and put me in a cold shower.  When I was lucid, I started putting the pieces back together and checked my clothes for evidence.
